question: _________ is the common name of Silicon Dioxide.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quartz.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Silicon Dioxide **is a chemical compound made up of **silicon and oxygen.**
 
• It is one of the most abundant minerals on **Earth** and can be found in **rocks, sand, and soil.**
 
• **Quartz** is the common name of **Silicon Dioxide.**
 
• Quartz is a mineral composed of **Silicon Dioxide.**
 
• It is a hard, transparent mineral that is often used in** jewelry and watches.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plaster of Paris** is a white powder made from gypsum.

 
 
• It is commonly used in **construction and art projects.**
 
 
 
• **Slaked Lime,** also known as Calcium Hydroxide, is a chemical compound made up of **calcium, hydrogen, and oxygen.**
 
 
• It is commonly used in **agriculture, construction, and food production.**
 
 
 
• **White Vitriol**, also known as Zinc Sulfate, is a chemical compound made up of **zinc, sulfur, and oxygen.**
 
 
• It is commonly used in** agriculture, medicine, and industrial processes.**
